messages:
alex: Quick thread to align owners for the 'launch lattice' item. Product wants a 2-stage plan but runtime/infra/security sequencing might reorder. Who owns gating + rollback?

ravi: I'm available. What are the expected peak RPS and p95 targets for GA vs pilot?

alex: GA target = 11k rps peak, p95 < 140ms/token. Pilot (opt-in) relaxed to p95 < 320ms. Pilot customers: 4 partners + internal.

jamal: Runtime note: pilot can use shared KV cache + TTLs. GA needs sharded caches and fair scheduling. Prewarm and canary plan required. Owner: runtime (jamal).

sofia: Security note: GA requires tenant key separation and HSM-backed KMS. HSM path ~3w + audit. Pilot allowed with software keys for opt-in customers, with enhanced logging. Owner: security.

ravi: Infra will reserve GPUs for pilot (6 replicas) and plan HSM provisioning for GA. I'll open INF ticket and estimate cost.

alex: Proposal: Stage 1 (Pilot) = 5w, Stage 2 (GA) = +4w after HSM signoff. Action owners: alex -> PRD + pilot list; jamal -> runtime runbook + prewarm; ravi -> infra ticket + capacity; sofia -> HSM gating checklist.

jamal: I'll draft the runbook and canary ramp (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with abort thresholds.

sofia: I'll post the gating checklist tomorrow AM. GA blocked until audit passes.

ansible-bot: ansible-bot: Created INF-10101 'launch-lattice pilot infra reservation' and linked this thread.

ravi: Thanks. Sync 30m tomorrow to lock timelines. React if you accept owners.

alex: Agree :white_check_mark:

jamal: Agree :white_check_mark:

sofia: Agree for pilot; GA requires HSM audit before open signup :white_check_mark:

ravi: Agree. I'll add ticket number to thread when created.
